description: This Python source file implements a client for bidirectional streaming communication with AWS SageMaker endpoints using HTTP/2. It provides methods for starting sessions, sending audio, text, and JSON data, receiving responses, and managing the connection lifecycle.

classes.name: SageMakerBidiClient
classes.description: Client class for managing bidirectional streaming with AWS SageMaker endpoints, including session management, data transmission, and response handling.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the SageMakerBidiClient with endpoint details and configuration parameters.

methods.name: _initialize_client
methods.description: Sets up the HTTP2 client with AWS credentials, resolving credentials from environment or metadata.

methods.name: start_session
methods.description: Starts a bidirectional streaming session, establishing connection and output stream.

methods.name: send_data
methods.description: Sends raw data bytes with optional data type header to the stream.

methods.description: Convenience method to send audio data as binary.
